title: Tidy Counterexample to the BLMR Security Implication
summary: The source leaves the existence of a tidy counterexample unresolved and calls its construction an interesting open question.

formal_statement.body: Construct a tidy encryption-scheme counterexample to the BLMR security implication.

scope.domain: Cryptographic-primitive design involving encryption schemes and the BLMR security implication.
scope.unresolved_remainder: A tidy encryption-scheme counterexample to the BLMR security implication remains to be constructed.

progress.summary: The source explicitly presents finding a tidy counter-example as an interesting open question.
citation_labels: Adam Everspaugh et al., Key Rotation for Authenticated Encryption
